import logging
import uuid


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class OrderService:
    def __init__(self, stock) -> None:
        self.stock = stock
        self._orders_placed = 0

    def place_order(
        self,
        user: str,
        item: str,
        quantity: int,
        is_admin: bool = False,
        note: str = "",
    ) -> tuple[int, str]:
        try:
            reservation_id = self.stock.reserve(item, quantity)
            message = f"Order confirmed. Reservation ID: {reservation_id}"
            if note:
                message += f". Note: {note}"
            self._orders_placed += 1
            return 200, message
        except Exception as exc:
            reference = uuid.uuid4().hex
            logger.exception("Unexpected order error; reference: %s", reference)

            message = f"An unexpected error occurred. Reference: {reference}"
            if is_admin:
                message += f" ({type(exc).__name__}: {exc})"
            return 500, message

    def cancel_order(self, reservation_id: int) -> tuple[int, str]:
        self.stock.release(reservation_id)
        return 200, f"Order cancelled. Reservation ID: {reservation_id}"

    def orders_placed(self) -> int:
        return self._orders_placed
```
